License texts of the components in Tsukuru Player (collected from the sources they were built from).
See THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md for what each one is used for. SDL2, TinySoundFont and a few single-header libraries
(stb, dr_libs, pl_mpeg) carry their license in their source headers: see SDL2-and-headers.txt.
